body:
Only for reference @bobylito but currently in magento it works like this:

Every browsers will use hash based navigation
- browsers implementing history api will use pushState/popstate
- browsers not implementing history api will use location.hash=../hashchange

So when providing the "hash" option it does not means we want to use location.hash and hashchange directly, depends of the browser support.

The use case to have hash based navigations in modern browsers using history API is when you cannot have urls like ?query=...&.. because no backend is able to understand it.

Hope it helps a lil bit. I struggled with it in magento at first.
